Enhanced anti-inflammatory efficacy of a new piroxicam analogue through the MEK/ERK/NF-κB pathway in vitro and in vivo. Piroxicam (PX) is potent and widely used for the treatment of inflammatory conditions. To develop active PX analogues with improved anti-inflammatory activity and minimized adverse effects, a series of PX analogues were designed and synthesized for enhancing anti-inflammatory activity.
